content: {"reasoning":"CPT 93229 requires prior authorization which is missing, and this payer offers neither a retroactive-authorization window nor peer-to-peer review, so there is no path to secure the required auth. Submitting clean would only yield an unavoidable auth denial with no appeal remedy (no denial-of-necessity issue, and no P2P), wasting touches. The missing-auth loss is the provider's responsibility, so the balance cannot be shifted to the patient beyond their share. The payer balance is therefore uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
